Header.description: Offline Map Object Header â€“ Standard OSD-OMO-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Offline Map Object is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Offline Map Object is or is intended to be located.

OfflineMapObjectID.description: Unique identifier of this Offline Map Object.

OfflineMapObjectTime.description: Time this Offline Map Object was produced.

OfflineMapObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Offline Map Object is located.

BasicOfflineObjectCount.description: Number of Basic Offline Map Objects contained in this Offline Map Object.

BasicOfflineObjects.description: Set of Basic Offline Map Objects contained in this Offline Map Object.

BasicOfflineObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Basic Offline Map Object is located within the containing Offline Map Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

BOObjectIDOrBOObject.description: Either the ID of a Basic Offline Map Object or the Basic Offline Map Object itself.

SubOfflineObjectCount.description: Number of child Offline Map Objects contained in this Offline Map Object.

SubOfflineObjects.description: Set of child Offline Map Objects contained in this Offline Map Object.

SubOfflineObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this child Offline Map Object is located within the containing Offline Map Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

SubOObjectIDOrSubOObject.description: Either the ID of a child Offline Map Object or the child Offline Map Object itself.

OObjectOrBOObject.description: A mixed array of Basic Offline Map Objects and child Offline Map Objects.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Offline Map Object in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Offline Map Object (plain text, max 2048 characters).
